record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace chronological position IDs with reverse-distance IDs: the newest nonpadding token receives position 1, preceding tokens receive 2, 3, etc., and padding remains 0. Apply this consistently to masked training sequences and appended-mask inference. Recency anchoring may transfer better across the predominantly short, variable-length histories. Preserve history selection, final-mask readout, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer; update the predictor writer consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Reverse-distance positions regressed in prior trials. Instead, preserve chronological positions for the first 16 tokens and compress later positions into pairs. This retains precise ordering for short histories while reducing positional fragmentation for longer histories, without truncating observed interactions. The generated predictor imports this same model class, so training and appended-mask inference share the position mapping and unchanged checkpoint shapes.
